ConnectionStrings._comment: PostgreSQL (adr/0005-hosting-pivot-self-hosted-vps-postgresql.md — supersedes Azure SQL Database). This is a local-dev default only; the production connection string (a least-privilege role, never the database owner/superuser — governance/raid.md D-004) is supplied via an environment variable / systemd EnvironmentFile, never committed here.

App._comment: Local-dev placeholder. Production is https://www.varangians.co.uk, set by deploy/systemd/vlms-web.service (App__PublicBaseUrl). Used to build the absolute accept-invite link in guardian invite emails (Guardianship/GuardianInviteService.cs) — a relative link would not survive being copied into an email client.

Storage._comment: Local-disk certificate/lesson-asset storage (adr/0005-hosting-pivot-self-hosted-vps-postgresql.md — supersedes Azure Blob Storage). LocalRootPath is optional: Storage/LocalDiskBlobStorage.cs's own DefaultRootPath (App_Data/blobs, relative to the process working directory) is used when this key is absent or blank. Production requires an absolute path outside the app directory, or startup fails (Storage/BlobStorageRoot.cs).

DataProtection._comment: Directory for the Data Protection key ring (auth cookies, guardian invite tokens) so it survives restarts. Required in Production (startup fails without it) — set by deploy/systemd/vlms-web.service to /var/lib/vlms/keys. Blank in Development uses the framework default (user profile). See Infrastructure/Security/VlmsDataProtection.cs.

GraphMail._comment: Microsoft Graph sendMail as the shared mailbox noreply@varangians.co.uk (adr/0005 amendment, 12/10/2026; Infrastructure/Notifications/GraphEmailSender.cs). TenantId/ClientId/SenderAddress are identifiers, not secrets. ClientSecret is a secret: PLACEHOLDER here, the real value only in the server's environment file as GraphMail__ClientSecret (deploy/README.md).
